tools.name: get_daily_brief
tools.title: Today's Celestia network brief
tools.description: Orion's latest daily analysis of the Celestia mainnet: headline, anomaly signals with severity, key network metrics, and provenance links for every figure. Start here for 'what is happening on Celestia today?'. Set include_narrative for Orion's written prose summary.

include_narrative.description: Also return Orion's written prose narrative (markdown, with a citation check)

tools.name: get_signals
tools.title: Anomaly signals
tools.description: Anomaly/health signals detected by Orion for a given day (default: latest). Each signal has type, severity (info|notable|critical), observed value vs rolling baseline, and its data source. Filter with min_severity.

date.description: Report date YYYY-MM-DD; omit for the latest report

min_severity.description: Only signals at or above this severity

tools.name: get_network_state
tools.title: Celestia network state
tools.description: Current Celestia mainnet metrics from Orion's latest snapshot: height, DA volume (TB), fees, validators (active vs registered), staking ratios, Nakamoto coefficient, jail count, TIA price — with provenance links.

tools.name: list_reports
tools.title: Report archive index
tools.description: Index of Orion's daily Celestia reports (date + signal counts), newest first.

tools.name: get_report
tools.title: Full daily report
tools.description: Full Orion report for a specific date (YYYY-MM-DD): snapshot metrics, all signals, summary, provenance.

date.description: Report date YYYY-MM-DD (see list_reports for available dates)

tools.name: search_reports
tools.title: Search the report archive
tools.description: Keyword search across recent daily reports (signal titles, details, types, metrics). Returns matching signals grouped by date. Plain keyword scan — no LLM in the loop, results are verbatim from the archive.

limit.description: How many recent reports to scan (default 14)

tools.name: get_trends
tools.title: Network trends (day-over-day)
tools.description: Day-over-day and week-over-week change for key Celestia metrics, computed from Orion's daily snapshots. Answers 'what changed since yesterday / last week?'.

tools.name: get_metric_history
tools.title: Metric history series
tools.description: Time series of one snapshot metric across Orion's daily reports, oldest to newest. Metrics: height, total_fee_tia, total_blobs_tb, total_tx, total_validators, active_validators, tia_price, bonded_ratio, bonded_ratio_supply, nakamoto_halting, jail_count.

tools.name: get_top_namespaces
tools.title: Top Celestia namespaces by DA volume
tools.description: Largest namespaces (rollups) on Celestia by total blob size, live from Celenium. Shows who is posting the most data to the DA layer.

tools.name: get_namespace
tools.title: Namespace detail
tools.description: Detail for a single Celestia namespace by its namespace_id (hex — get one from get_top_namespaces): size, blob count, last activity.

tools.name: get_top_validators
tools.title: Top Celestia validators by stake
tools.description: Largest Celestia validators by stake, live from Celenium: moniker, stake (TIA), commission, jailed status.

prompts.name: daily_celestia_briefing
prompts.title: Daily Celestia briefing
prompts.description: Produce a grounded daily briefing on Celestia using Orion's tools.

prompts.name: rollup_da_check
prompts.title: Rollup DA landscape check
prompts.description: Survey who posts the most data to Celestia and the current DA cost context.

resources.name: latest-brief
resources.title: Latest Celestia daily brief
resources.description: Orion's most recent daily Celestia report (JSON).

resources.name: report-index
resources.title: Report archive index
resources.description: Index of Orion's daily Celestia reports (date + signal counts).
